note: THE RIGHTS COLUMN. Ruling 74, F5 Part 3, built in F6 on 2026-09-06. Ruling 74 lets an in-copyright source be cited and quoted under four conditions declared in the record, and the third is that the rights position is stated verbatim -- and where a source states no terms, that the record says THAT, in those words. Nothing could read the column: `citation_original` is free prose, ingest.verify does not open it, and F6_START's debt list records the consequence -- 'the corpus sits in at least four rights states and the position is recoverable only by reading 40 records by hand.'
why_this_file_is_not_inside_the_records: For data/corpus_tiers.json's reason, one file over and unchanged: a `rights` key on a seed record would move that record's content_hash and therefore corpus_digest, and doing it to all 40 at once would re-hash the whole corpus to add a field that describes the SOURCE rather than the text. The sidecar lives in data/ where no corpus walk reaches it -- iter_seed_records refuses any .json under the corpus directory that is not at region/record.json depth.
why_it_is_not_DERIVED_from_citation_orig: Because it cannot be, and the attempt is FINDING 69's defect with a regular expression in front of it. citation_original is prose written by a curator; a matcher over it would find the word `open` in a sentence about REACHABILITY -- which is exactly the two-facts-one-word failure FINDING 69 records, four times, in this repository's own hunt documents. A rights position is READ BY A PERSON, off the object, and this file records who read it and when. What the instrument checks is the SHAPE and the COVERAGE, never the content.

vocabulary.open_licence_stated: A named open licence, stated on the object read and quoted verbatim below.
vocabulary.public_domain: Out of copyright by age, or carrying a public-domain mark, stated on the object read.
vocabulary.all_rights_reserved: A reserved-rights statement. Ruling 74's four conditions apply in full or the source is not taken.
vocabulary.states_no_terms: The object was reached and states no terms of any kind. Ruling 74: the record says THAT, in those words. NOT the same as `unread` -- this is a reading whose answer was nothing, and that is the answer.
vocabulary.two_positions_stated: The source states MORE THAN ONE rights position and they do not agree. parsigdatabase.com is the first: an attribution-only permission and an all-rights-reserved notice, five lines apart in the same footer. The record quotes both, verbatim, in the order they appear, and adjudicates neither.
vocabulary.unread: NOBODY HAS READ THIS SOURCE'S RIGHTS POSITION SINCE FINDING 69. Not a state of the source: a state of this project's knowledge of it. FINDING 69, F5 Part 3: 'Every other licence claim in this repository is now suspect until re-read.' This is that sentence made countable.

why_unread_is_the_default_and_not_a_gues: Thirty-eight of forty records enter this file as `unread`, and the temptation to fill them from the prose already in citation_original is the whole reason the file exists. FINDING 69 was produced by two licence claims that were WRONG in opposite directions in a single session -- one recorded reachability as a licence, one verified a licence against the wrong object. A column populated from those same sentences would inherit both errors and print them as a table. An unread cell is a debt with a name; a guessed cell is a finding waiting.

arabia-05-ruwafa.note: READ OFF THE BOOK'S FRONT MATTER AND NOT THE CHAPTER'S -- the chapter that is actually cited carries no front matter at all. That is half of FINDING 69: a licence verified against the wrong object. The issue date 2021-04-26 that F5_CANDIDATES.md carries was on neither page and is not asserted anywhere.

arabia-06-syllaeus.note: The other half of FINDING 69, from the opposite direction. F5_CANDIDATES.md recorded this source as 'the one verified open'. It is REACHABLE -- a deposit in the Hungarian Academy of Sciences' repository at real.mtak.hu, free to read under a repository policy -- and it is under NO Creative Commons licence at all. Reachable and licensed are two facts and one word was carrying both.
